title: Get FEM Plugin Working End to End
description: Get fem plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏗️fem) working end to end: Rust compiles and tests pass (engine, 2d/3d artifacts, receiving, sqlite, bridge), TS packages build/test, plugin loads in s and exposes its artifacts. Opus 5.5 coordinates, Sonnet 5.5 agents execute, Haiku 5.5 agents explore/audit. Fall back to native tools if the shared work fleet mechanism fails. Fix fundamental unrelated issues found along the way.
summary: FEM plugin works end to end in the browser on the clean wasm e68c95d3 (no temporary prints). 2D: full browser smoke rc=0, Converged 36/512 initially, Converged 49/512 after editing n1 X=1.5 and clicking away, Live Load reaction Ty 12000 N. 3D: Preparing analysis, Solving loads, then results Case: dead after 44 s with no interaction and 0 faults. Fixes: pending effects admitted under their owning instance; roster config partitions for unaddressed windows; TS publishSpawnedJobTerminal repaints the final job frame; child operation identity from the host-bound operation; 2D inspection control_row accessible name; press settlement deadlock (the Commit waited on the tool follow's read lease, which only leftover-budget maintenance advanced), so settle_press now drives the follow, with law a_press_commit_blocked_by_the_follow_read_drives_the_follow (passes natively); panels crate dev-dependency enables artifact-app-testing. Native: law 1/1, 2D inspection 16/16. Open note: the typing settlement has the same read-lease guard. Details in fem-browser-e2e.md.
